errorCodes.title: Loss of Signal (LOS)
errorCodes.description: ONT is not receiving any optical signal from the OLT
causes: Splice failure or break in fiber path
fixes: Check fiber connection at ONT – ensure SC/APC connector is fully seated
Inspect fiber for visible damage, kinks, or tight bends
Clean fiber connectors with lint-free wipe
Check OLT port status in Calix Cloud
If outdoor fiber, check for storm/animal damage
May require dispatch for fiber repair

errorCodes.title: Loss of Frame (LOF)
errorCodes.description: ONT receiving signal but cannot sync with OLT framing
fixes: Check Rx power levels – should be between -8 and -25 dBm for GPON
If Rx power good, try rebooting ONT
Check for fiber path issues (bad splices, dirty connectors)
Verify ONT is provisioned correctly in Calix Cloud
May need attenuator if signal too strong

errorCodes.title: Signal Degraded (SD)
errorCodes.description: ONT signal quality below threshold but still operational
fixes: Check and log current Rx power levels
Clean fiber connectors
Monitor for further degradation
Schedule preventive maintenance if persistent

errorCodes.title: Registration Failure
fixes: Verify ONT serial number matches provisioning
Check account status – is service active?
Re-provision ONT in Calix Cloud
Check if ONT needs firmware update
Factory reset ONT if all else fails

errorCodes.title: DHCP Failure
errorCodes.description: Router unable to obtain WAN IP address
fixes: Verify WAN VLAN settings in Calix Cloud
Check ONT link status first
Reboot router to retry DHCP
Check service profile assignment
Verify no MAC address conflicts

errorCodes.title: Wi-Fi Interference Detected
errorCodes.description: High interference on current Wi-Fi channel
causes: Too many devices on single band
fixes: Enable auto channel selection in Calix Cloud
Check Wi-Fi analytics for channel recommendations
Move 2.4GHz devices to 5GHz where possible
Consider adding mesh satellite for coverage

errorCodes.title: Mesh Backhaul Weak
errorCodes.description: Mesh satellite has poor backhaul connection to primary
fixes: Move satellite closer to primary unit
Check placement – avoid metal objects, appliances
Run mesh optimization in CommandIQ
Consider wired backhaul if available

errorCodes.title: Firmware Update Available
errorCodes.description: Newer firmware version available for device
fixes: Schedule firmware update during off-peak hours
Verify auto-update settings in Calix Cloud
Manually trigger update if urgent (security patch)

errorCodes.title: Device Offline
errorCodes.description: Router not reporting to Calix Cloud
fixes: Verify power at location (call customer if needed)
Check ONT status – is it online?
If power confirmed, may need truck roll
Check for area-wide outages first

commonIssues.title: Slow Wi-Fi Speeds
symptoms: Speed test shows low results on Wi-Fi
quickChecks: Run speed test on wired connection to confirm issue is Wi-Fi
Check which band device is connected to (2.4GHz vs 5GHz)
Check device count on network in Calix Cloud
Review Wi-Fi analytics for interference
commonIssues.resolution: If 2.4GHz, try forcing to 5GHz. Check for interference. Consider adding mesh satellite if coverage issue.

commonIssues.title: No Internet Connection
quickChecks: Check PON/Link LED on ONT or GigaCenter
Check Internet LED status
Verify account is active in billing
Check Calix Cloud for device status
commonIssues.resolution: If PON light red/off, fiber issue. If Internet LED red, DHCP/provisioning issue. Start with power cycle.

commonIssues.title: Intermittent Connection Drops
quickChecks: Check Rx power history for fluctuations
Look for Wi-Fi roaming issues if mesh
Check for thermal throttling (unit hot?)
Review event logs in Calix Cloud
commonIssues.resolution: If optical levels fluctuating, possible fiber issue. If Wi-Fi only, check interference and roaming settings.

commonIssues.title: New Device Won't Connect
symptoms: Device sees network but won't connect
quickChecks: Verify correct SSID and password
Check if device limit reached
Try connecting to different band
Check for MAC filtering
commonIssues.resolution: Have customer forget network and reconnect. Check password in CommandIQ. Verify no MAC filtering active.

commonIssues.title: Phone/VoIP Problems
quickChecks: Check phone port LED status
Verify phone is plugged into correct port (Phone 1)
Test with different phone handset
Check voice service status in provisioning
commonIssues.resolution: If no dial tone, check provisioning. If quality issues, check for QoS settings and network congestion.

commonIssues.title: CommandIQ App Issues
quickChecks: Verify phone is on same network as router
Check app is updated to latest version
Verify router is online in Calix Cloud
Try on Wi-Fi vs cellular
commonIssues.resolution: Force close and reopen app. If still failing, have customer uninstall/reinstall. Check router connectivity.

quickTips.title: Optimal Router Placement
quickTips.tip: Central location, elevated (not on floor), away from metal objects and appliances. Keep away from microwaves, baby monitors, and cordless phones.

quickTips.title: 5GHz vs 2.4GHz
quickTips.tip: 5GHz = faster but shorter range, best for streaming/gaming near router. 2.4GHz = slower but better wall penetration, use for IoT and distant devices.

quickTips.title: Reading Rx Power
quickTips.tip: GPON optimal range: -8 to -25 dBm. Above -8 = too strong (may need attenuator). Below -25 = weak signal, investigate fiber path.

quickTips.title: Factory Reset
quickTips.tip: Hold reset button 10+ seconds until LEDs flash. Device returns to defaults. Will need re-provisioning after reset.

quickTips.title: Fiber Connector Care
quickTips.tip: SC/APC connectors (green) are angled. Never look into connector. Clean with lint-free wipe. Push and twist to seat properly.

quickTips.title: Mesh Placement
quickTips.tip: Satellites should be 25-40 feet from primary with 1-2 walls max. Too far = weak backhaul. Too close = wasted coverage overlap.
